I think there's number one what you need out of Washington is you need leadership. We need to set some clear objectives. I think the clearest objective that we can establish that says in 20 years we're going to be energy independent. That doesn't mean we don't import any energy from overseas, but it says instead of importing 60 percent of our energy, we're maybe down to 15 to 20 percent and we want to get on a path to go down that direction. Then I think what we need to do is we need to open up the country to more exploration, American exploration for American oil. Right now we have proven reserves of 21 billion barrels of oil. But those reserves are current technology, current prices in those areas where the federal government will actually allow you to explore and extract oil and gas from. If you work with that little feature called federal regulations, it's estimated that our proven reserves can go into the hundreds of billions of barrels of oil and cubic feet of gas if we allow more American exploration. Let's say we achieve over the next five years, get that 60% down to 50%. That's $80 billion that stays in the United States where we're buying American energy that's not going to Venezuela, Nigeria, or the Middle East. I think that'd be a big move forward. The other thing that I think we need to do is we need to have exploration of new ideas. It's not about just exploring where there's more oil. We got to unleash the American potential for an initiative for innovation. Like I said, this is what's going on at Merrick. Alternative sources of energy. New ways to produce electricity. There's some exciting things going there. We have to take a look at biomass, ethanol, and those types of things. And then you look at conservation, and you do a little bit in each of these areas. And it's amazing how quick you can have a major impact. But from my perspective, there's no single bullet. There are a lot of little things that we can do that can move us towards that goal. I really think that energy independence within 20 years is an achievable goal.
